sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Atul Kumar Singh Gaur, learned counsel for the
complainant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2.  In terms of the FIR, a missing person report alleging that the applicant had enticed away the daughter of the informant, subsequently in the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that the applicant had taken her on 05.07.2023 to Charbagh and thereafter did not return back, no wrong was alleged against the applicant.
In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she was in love with the applicant and the applicant had taken her to Lucknow where physical relations were also formed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The tentative age of the victim is around 16 years, although no formal determination of age has been carried out so far.

3. Learned A.G.A. as well as the counsel for the complainant strongly opposed the bail prayer by arguing that in the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. the allegation was leveled against the applicant, however, they do not deny that the medical does not support the allegation.

4. Considering the statement under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 17.07.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Kuldeep be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 177 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Asoha, District Unnao, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
